name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.3: Bugfix — large traces now learn reliably (send via --transcript file, not --stdin). ace_after_task.py sent the ExecutionTrace to ace-cli learn via --stdin (subprocess input=), but learn --stdin cannot read payloads larger than the ~64KB OS pipe buffer — it errors {"message":"Failed to read from stdin"} and the producer gets a BrokenPipe, so ANY trace over ~64KB silently failed to learn (main AND subagent). truncate_trace's 2MB cap is far above the ~64KB cliff, so it never mitigated this (empirically: 64KB ok, 80KB fails; 1/2/4MB fail; a 3.25MB --transcript file stores OK). Fix: new _learn_via_transcript() writes the trace to a temp file and invokes ace-cli learn --transcript <file> (no pipe-buffer limit); the temp file is always unlinked. STEP 8 now calls it. Large/complex sessions (many tools or large tool responses) now learn reliably — a likely contributor to under-warmed bandits for complex orgs, alongside v6.6.0 (subagent writer) and v6.6.2 (subagent transcript crash). The underlying ace-cli learn --stdin not draining stdin is an SDK-side bug (reported separately); --transcript is the complete client-side workaround. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
